title: Fetish levels
summary: What each level of fetish means.

claims.text: Level four fetishes have unusual, potent effects over time or devastating single effects, and level four weapons give even other Garou pause; they often become part of the bearer’s name.
Level five fetishes are the greatest of the great, able to work miracles; they are often tribal treasures that can overshadow their owners.
Level six fetishes are never made by Garou at will; Incarnae create them from trusted servants, parts of themselves or their own surrender, and helping create one is the aim of a whole chronicle.

title: Making a fetish
summary: Preparing the parts and the maker.

claims.text: The maker gathers and prepares both the physical object and the spirit; the plainer or uglier the object offered, the less likely a spirit is to accept it.
Self-preparation can use the Rite of Cleansing, and the Storyteller may make the later Rite of the Fetish 1 easier for every success beyond the fetish’s level.
Whoever performs the cleansing must know that rite, and once the spirit is contacted the maker must fully commit to the design.

title: Cursed fetishes
summary: How fetishes turn against their bearers.

claims.text: No fixed rules decide when a fetish becomes cursed; generally it happens when the fetish has plainly been mistreated, at the Storyteller’s judgment.
Spirits forced into a fetish rebel far more readily than those properly asked for help.
Corruption is another cause, as with a lost klaive found in the bones of a long-dead Wyrm-beast.

title: Sun Whip
summary: A level three fetish against vampires.

claims.text: A Sun Whip is a bullwhip woven with gold nuggets and a heavy nugget at the tip, bound with a sunlight or fire spirit; Gnosis 7.
When activated it glows, and on striking a vampire bursts into sunlight or flame, dealing Strength + 4 aggravated damage.
In the legend, the Silent Strider Ahroun Inihue returned to Egypt in the reign of Mentuhotep III to find husband and son drained by a Wyrm-serpent.
Inihue had left them a charm bearing the signs of Helios, Luna and Owl and promised it would keep them safe, but it was not a promise Inihue had the power to make.
